sloka: स ब्राह्मणस्याश्रममभ्युपेत्य महात्मनो देवपुरोहितस्य ।ददर्श रम्योटजवृक्षषण्डं महद्वनं विप्रवरस्य रम्यम् ।। २.८९.२२ ।।
transliteration: sa brāhmaṇasyāśramamabhyupetya mahātmano devapurohitasya ।dadarśa ramyoṭajavṛkṣaṣaṇḍaṁ mahadvanaṁ vipravarasya ramyam ।। 2.89.22 ।।

translations.english: The noble Bharata, got his army encamped according to their pleasure and set out, accompanied by his priests, to see the distinguished sage Bharadwaja.
